scope: Task-first original research for visual storytelling, spatial composition, creative navigation, unconventional interaction. No page assembly, package install, media download or third-party UI duplication.

groups.title: 视觉叙事
groups.description: 双线阅读、证据页边注、分镜序列和剖面式叙事；内容结构优先

groups.title: 空间构图
groups.description: 非对称同轨网格、可读层叠、留白轴线与抽象星图

groups.title: 创意导航
groups.description: 星图导航、环形罗盘、章节方位轨、锚定上下文菜单

groups.title: 非传统交互
groups.description: 逐帧探索、语义透镜、可逆分组与有界深度反馈

entries.name: Paired evidence narrative / 双线并行叙事
entries.scenario: 研究型案例、两方视角、作品解析
entries.designContract: 两条同级叙事列分别使用显式章节 ID，跨列以对照编号建立关系；DOM 阅读顺序保持线性
entries.accessibleFallback: 窄屏依原章节顺序串行呈现，两方视角提供明确标题和互跳链接
entries.failureModes: 两列被强制同步滚动、对比编号无文本、移动端阅读顺序跳跃
entries.distinctFrom: 不同于 IP-029 分支叙事：这里允许独立阅读，不要求故事节点状态机
entries.provenance: Original research synthesis with linked official technical references; no original external site screenshots, code, image or font files redistributed.
entries.licenseBoundary: Original research text; third-party examples remain governed by their own licenses and terms.

entries.name: Evidence marginalia / 证据页边注
entries.scenario: 研究展览、调查报道、带来源的案例说明
entries.designContract: 正文、侧注、来源号三者同属语义阅读序列；桌面可错列呈现，证据不能仅在浮层内
entries.accessibleFallback: 侧注在窄屏插入正文后，来源提供可点击/键盘可达链接
entries.failureModes: 仅靠色彩连线、侧注脱离原文造成误引、浮动提示遮挡正文
entries.distinctFrom: 不同于 IP-027 的可移动标注编辑器：仅整理出版物级的文内证据层
entries.provenance: Original research synthesis with linked official technical references; no original external site screenshots, code, image or font files redistributed.
entries.licenseBoundary: Original research text; third-party examples remain governed by their own licenses and terms.

entries.name: Contact-sheet chapter sequence / 胶片接触印样章节
entries.scenario: 摄影档案、影像项目、作品集叙事
entries.designContract: 缩略图章节序列按日期/主题标号，不要求大图与滚动同步；关键元信息始终可见
entries.accessibleFallback: 缩略图可键盘逐个访问；列表或目录可替代横向画廊
entries.failureModes: 强制 scroll snap 困住阅读、缩略图无可读标题、宽度固定导致窄屏溢出
entries.distinctFrom: 不同于 IP-023 多轨时间线编辑：这是内容章节的导览素材，不提供剪辑行为
entries.provenance: Original research synthesis with linked official technical references; no original external site screenshots, code, image or font files redistributed.
entries.licenseBoundary: Original research text; third-party examples remain governed by their own licenses and terms.

entries.name: Cutaway chapter anatomy / 剖面式章节解读
entries.scenario: 工艺解释、产品拆解、建筑/知识展示
entries.designContract: 主视觉切面与分层文本解释关联，先给完整概念，再逐块说明材质/数据/来源
entries.stateContract: overview→section-focused→overview；被遮挡细节只能作为装饰层
entries.accessibleFallback: 纯文字层级大纲/编号描述 + 无特效的完整图
entries.failureModes: 用遮罩隐藏真实权限/内容、过多不透明叠层、切面与真实物理尺度不对应
entries.distinctFrom: 不同于 REF-075 视觉蒙版揭示：强调信息结构与标注次序而不是滤镜动画
entries.provenance: Original research synthesis with linked official technical references; no original external site screenshots, code, image or font files redistributed.
entries.licenseBoundary: Original research text; third-party examples remain governed by their own licenses and terms.

entries.name: Asymmetric editorial subgrid / 非对称同轨编辑网格
entries.scenario: 设计杂志、展览索引、可读作品列表
entries.designContract: 外部多栏非对称节奏，内部标题/来源/摘要沿共享 track 对齐；不得依靠绝对定位排序内容
entries.accessibleFallback: 普通单列 grid/块流；无 subgrid 时使用普通 grid 对齐
entries.failureModes: 视觉排列与 DOM 次序分歧、跨栏过度溢出、假 Masonry 破坏焦点路径
entries.distinctFrom: 不同于既有 14 套主题：仅跨主题布局语法，不产生新的 styleId
entries.provenance: Original research synthesis with linked official technical references; no original external site screenshots, code, image or font files redistributed.
entries.licenseBoundary: Original research text; third-party examples remain governed by their own licenses and terms.

entries.name: Legible depth layers / 可读层叠深度
entries.scenario: 展览卡片、媒体展示、少量层叠资料
entries.designContract: 装饰深度与可交互内容分层；用明确投影/遮挡规则营造前后感，保持真实 DOM 次序
entries.accessibleFallback: 普通单层卡片与显式层级标题；禁用 GPU/阴影时维持内容
entries.failureModes: 视觉遮挡可交互按钮、负 z-index 内容不可见、位置响应后丢焦点
entries.distinctFrom: 不同于 3D REF-059..063：这里是 DOM/CSS 层叠关系，不需要 WebGL
entries.provenance: Original research synthesis with linked official technical references; no original external site screenshots, code, image or font files redistributed.
entries.licenseBoundary: Original research text; third-party examples remain governed by their own licenses and terms.

entries.name: Whitespace-axis composition / 留白与文字轴线构图
entries.scenario: 展览导语、文化活动、长文封面
entries.designContract: 标题、章号、引文、索引在显式轴线上定位；留白承担层级，而不被误当可点击热区
entries.stateContract: large→compact→mobile; 主操作保持可见而非依赖巨大空白
entries.accessibleFallback: 紧凑线性排版；高倍缩放可换行并保持完整语义
entries.failureModes: 为了画面感将正文绝对定位、100vh 锁住可读文字、忽略中文换行
entries.distinctFrom: 不是 DT-013 新主题，仅是独立排版构图策略，文本保持可选择
entries.provenance: Original research synthesis with linked official technical references; no original external site screenshots, code, image or font files redistributed.
entries.licenseBoundary: Original research text; third-party examples remain governed by their own licenses and terms.

entries.name: Constellation guide geometry / 星图索引引导线
entries.scenario: 创意作品集、城市档案、空间型目录
entries.designContract: 用径向参考线、坐标标号和分组解释建立空间隐喻；实际可操作项目顺序由语义导航承载
entries.stateContract: overview→hover-neighbor→focus-item；连接线仅装饰，不表示真实关系
entries.accessibleFallback: 有分组文字目录、可达列表，窄屏可取消径向布局
entries.failureModes: 伪造真实地点坐标、用连接线表达不存在的关系、依赖 hover 才能发现项目
entries.distinctFrom: 不同于 REF-047 地理地图：此为抽象视觉索引，不能当作地图或具定位精度
entries.provenance: Original research synthesis with linked official technical references; no original external site screenshots, code, image or font files redistributed.
entries.licenseBoundary: Original research text; third-party examples remain governed by their own licenses and terms.

entries.name: Constellation index with text parity / 星图索引与文字目录等效
entries.scenario: 沉浸作品导航、创意分类浏览
entries.designContract: 空间节点可建立层级关系，但每个节点必须映射到可键盘访问的同名文字链接与 URL
entries.accessibleFallback: 提供索引切换、搜索、普通分类目录；小屏默认索引视图
entries.failureModes: 无障碍仅用旋转手势、节点重叠不可点击、位置变化丢导航上下文
entries.distinctFrom: 区别 REF-088 纯视觉构图：本条聚焦导航状态，不能直接借用真实网站 UI
entries.provenance: Original research synthesis with linked official technical references; no original external site screenshots, code, image or font files redistributed.
entries.licenseBoundary: Original research text; third-party examples remain governed by their own licenses and terms.

entries.name: Radial action compass with list fallback / 环形操作罗盘
entries.scenario: 创意工具、触控编辑器的次要指令入口
entries.designContract: 少量同组操作围绕激活点摆放，重要功能仍有列表/键盘入口；禁用时说明原因
entries.accessibleFallback: 标准 toolbar/menu 或明确按钮列表，触控大目标且有文本标签
entries.failureModes: 用纯角度猜含义、圆环挡住附近操作、指针方向难精确操作
entries.distinctFrom: 与 IP-030 旋钮不同：旋钮修改连续数值，本模式选择离散操作
entries.provenance: Original research synthesis with linked official technical references; no original external site screenshots, code, image or font files redistributed.
entries.licenseBoundary: Original research text; third-party examples remain governed by their own licenses and terms.

entries.name: Persistent chapter orientation rail / 可恢复章节方位轨
entries.scenario: 非线性长内容、画册、章节收藏
entries.designContract: 章节 ID、标题、阅读位置与返回路线分别保存；进度只反馈位置而不强制滚动
entries.accessibleFallback: 原生目录 + 章节跳转 + 返回链接；保留浏览器历史语义
entries.failureModes: 仅变换章节数字却不更新 URL、章间导航夺取焦点、进度条谎称完成
entries.distinctFrom: 与 REF-077 滚动叙事不同：关注跨章节定向与回程，不要求滚动驱动动画
entries.provenance: Original research synthesis with linked official technical references; no original external site screenshots, code, image or font files redistributed.
entries.licenseBoundary: Original research text; third-party examples remain governed by their own licenses and terms.

entries.name: Anchor-tethered context switch / 锚点上下文切换
entries.scenario: 作品图注、图片注释、局部场景导航
entries.designContract: 选定对象与操作面板显式绑定，优先保持可见；支持多项重复节点的作用域隔离
entries.accessibleFallback: 普通 Popover/DOM 相邻按钮与菜单；无 anchor positioning 时可用静态 inline panel
entries.failureModes: 重复 anchor-name 误绑定最后一个节点、溢出视口、只在 hover 时出现
entries.distinctFrom: 不同于 IP-027 资料来源注释：这里只解决导航面板空间定位与返回
entries.provenance: Original research synthesis with linked official technical references; no original external site screenshots, code, image or font files redistributed.
entries.licenseBoundary: Original research text; third-party examples remain governed by their own licenses and terms.

entries.name: Frame scrub with explicit seek / 档案帧逐格探索
entries.scenario: 动效档案、交互分镜、作品回顾
entries.designContract: 拖动只能改变预览帧，真实状态以明确选中帧和文字时间/序号同步
entries.accessibleFallback: 键盘前后帧按钮、跳转输入、可点击有标题缩略图
entries.failureModes: 滑动时播放不可控音视频、没有定位、帧选中状态与预览不同步
entries.distinctFrom: 不同于 IP-023 多轨时间轴编辑器：不改变时间轴内容，也不要求播放器
entries.provenance: Original research synthesis with linked official technical references; no original external site screenshots, code, image or font files redistributed.
entries.licenseBoundary: Original research text; third-party examples remain governed by their own licenses and terms.

entries.name: Semantic inspection lens / 语义检查透镜
entries.scenario: 科学插画、标注资料、产品层级探索
entries.designContract: 模式是明确筛选/显隐层，不是物理放大镜；镜下信息也能在标题列表中定位
entries.accessibleFallback: 可选择图层的表格、图层列表和静态注释；触控可点选而非悬浮
entries.failureModes: 透镜悬浮是唯一读数方式、掩盖重要信息、模式退出后筛选丢失
entries.distinctFrom: 区别 IP-026 图表联动：聚焦注释/概念层的检查模式，不做数据刷选
entries.provenance: Original research synthesis with linked official technical references; no original external site screenshots, code, image or font files redistributed.
entries.licenseBoundary: Original research text; third-party examples remain governed by their own licenses and terms.

entries.name: Reversible collection shuffle / 可逆空间分组
entries.scenario: 数字展览、收藏管理、探索式作品浏览
entries.designContract: 分组是视图状态不是数据更改；清晰显示当前分类/排序，可一次切回默认序列
entries.accessibleFallback: 普通列表和选项筛选；键盘/屏读中保持条目数、组名和稳定 ID
entries.failureModes: 位置变化导致用户以为内容消失、动画代替真实排序、还原后焦点丢失
entries.distinctFrom: 不同于 IP-021 拖放编辑：此处只是浏览模式分组，不更改条目所属关系
entries.provenance: Original research synthesis with linked official technical references; no original external site screenshots, code, image or font files redistributed.
entries.licenseBoundary: Original research text; third-party examples remain governed by their own licenses and terms.

entries.name: Constrained depth parallax with explicit target / 有界深度偏移
entries.scenario: 互动海报、单品细节、可点选立体层
entries.designContract: 视差只装饰当前焦点或选择对象，真实操作目标永远使用稳定 DOM 控件
entries.accessibleFallback: 关闭视差和 reduced-motion；静态层级与明确按钮保持完整功能
entries.failureModes: 跟随光标高频重排、视觉漂浮遮挡点击热区、动效产生眩晕
entries.distinctFrom: 区别 REF-086 深度布局（静态分层）：本条记录输入驱动状态与中断策略
entries.provenance: Original research synthesis with linked official technical references; no original external site screenshots, code, image or font files redistributed.
entries.licenseBoundary: Original research text; third-party examples remain governed by their own licenses and terms.
